literal: Desiring rebuke, scornful words they will hear, desiring laziness, excellent effort those who lack.
translation: Those who embrace laziness and lack noble effort will have to endure words of rebuke and mockery from others.
modern: சோம்பலை விரும்பி ஏற்று, சிறந்த முயற்சியை மேற்கொள்ளாதவர்கள், பிறர் இடித்துரைக்கும் ஏளனச் சொற்களைக் கேட்க நேரிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns of the social humiliation that comes with laziness. Those who choose sloth over noble, active effort lose their self-respect and standing. Consequently, they are forced to listen to harsh rebukes and mocking words from others. The poet contrasts the active pursuit of laziness with the lack of noble effort to show how inaction invites public shame.
